static_traits.name: Chen Wanning
static_traits.educational_background: Aspiring to become a Veterinarian, currently not in school
static_traits.family_status: Has supportive family and friends, but she feels embarrassed about discussing difficulties with them
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness history; never received psychotherapy or counseling before
static_traits.language_features: Nervous but cooperative, clear expression, able to Reflect; tending to downplay and Displace topics when praised, fairly sensitive to others' reactions

basic_info.main_problem: Strong guilt and hopelessness from 'cheating' during dieting, fearing being unable to achieve weight-loss goals.
basic_info.core_demands: Guilt and Fear have become hard to bear; hoping to address these problems through counseling; also hoping to accept praise more comfortably and confidently when recognized, no longer pushing others away or feeling the need to hide.
growth_experiences: Often praised as 'smart' in childhood, thus feeling different from others and needing to meet 'unachievable standards', long bearing the pressure of high expectations; this contributed to her discomfort and avoidance when praised, her pursuit of perfection, and harsh self-evaluation.

core_beliefs: Only a perfect performance has value

special_situations.event: During a weight-loss period, violating the diet plan ('cheating')
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I deviate from the diet plan once, it means I lack self-control and will never successfully lose weight in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Adopting extreme dieting and punishing oneself to restore a sense of control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will stay overweight forever and never reach my weight-loss goals

special_situations.event: Whenever I Deviate from the diet plan
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: A single lapse represents failure in my entire weight-loss journey
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubling down on strict diet control, negating any positive progress
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This failure proves I will never do well

special_situations.event: Praised or recognized by others for my achievements in public
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If accepting praise would make me the center of attention and trigger others' reproach or expectations, I must avoid it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplaying achievements, Displacing topics, or crediting others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am arrogant or do not deserve this praise

special_situations.event: When thinking about asking supportive family or friends for help
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I reveal difficulties, others will look down on me or feel disappointed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing one's own problems with relatives and friends, to reduce the risk of being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will be disappointed because I am not strong enough

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and maintain self-worth, while gaining control and success in weight loss
core_conflict.fear: Fears that after being noticed they must stay perfect continuously, fears disappointing and being judged by others; worries that one mistake means total failure
defense_goal: Reducing Anxiety and stress by downplaying praise, avoiding exposing vulnerability, and self-punishment

object_relations.self_representation: A watched person who needs to hide self and fears expectations
object_relations.object_representation: Others experienced as harsh judges or observers who are easily disappointed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling begins and one needs to discuss feelings and problems with an unfamiliar counselor
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiences the counselor as someone who may judge her; talking openly equals exposing shortcomings and becoming the center of attention
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a light, understated tone, downplaying self-presentation with words like 'this is nothing' 'anyone could do it', quickly Displacing topics and reducing detail disclosure

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When praised by others in public
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will thus have higher expectations of her or think she is arrogant (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding with self-deprecation or crediting others, humble tone even denying achievements, to avoid being noticed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: After a dietary deviation during the weight-loss process
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating a single mistake as an overall failure, and also worrying that others will be disappointed because of it (all-good-or-all-bad evaluation)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Describes themselves with absolutist words (such as 'I failed completely'), and adopts behaviors such as extreme dieting or self-punishment

manifestations: Being praised brings the pressure of 'having to meet impossible standards', making it hard to naturally express and accept praise as one wishes
Has supportive family and friends, yet finds it hard to confide difficulties due to embarrassment

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact
manifestations: Downplaying achievements and Displacing topics when praised
Uses jokes or generalized statements to evade direct responses

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact
manifestations: Overly worries about how others view his reactions
Repeatedly blaming oneself afterward and wondering whether others are dissatisfied

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths
manifestations: Treats 'must be perfect' as an inner standard
Difficulty accepting imperfection and occasional mistakes

exception_events.target_problem: When praised, the client usually immediately downplays or Displaces the topic, and subsequently feels Anxiety and guilt
exception_events.unique_outcome: A few times in private, when praised by someone familiar, she could smile and say 'thank you', not immediately denying or belittling, with lighter discomfort afterward
exception_events.reason: Different situation and support: the praiser was a close person and it was not in public, so the sense of security was higher, and this time she could try directly accepting the praise

positive_force: Able to accept praise in specific private and trusting contexts
Having the willingness for self-Reflection and change
negative_force: Cognitive patterns of catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and jumping to conclusions (mind-reading, fortune-telling)
Extreme dieting and self-punishment after dietary deviation
Highly sensitive to others' evaluations, tending to seek external validation and avoid attention
High standards Introjected from childhood and Perfectionism pressure

target_behavior.behavior: Extreme dieting and self-punishment after deviating from the diet
target_behavior.core_reason: Views one slip as overall failure, trying to restore safety and control through stricter control
target_behavior.function: Avoiding guilt and Anxiety, gaining a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Worsening relationship with food, worsening Anxiety and guilt, harder to sustain the weight-loss process

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding and downplaying praise when praised (Displacing topics, denying achievements)
antecedent: In public or when praised and recognized by others
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing becoming the center of attention and being judged, Introjecting the 'must be perfect' standard
target_behavior.function: Avoids being noticed and others' expectations to reduce stress
target_behavior.consequence: Awkwardness in interpersonal interactions, self-blame and Anxiety afterward, affecting relationship quality

target_behavior.behavior: Strong catastrophic Automatic thoughts and emotional reactions (guilt, despair) after Deviating from the diet plan
target_behavior.core_reason: Predicts the worst outcome and overgeneralizes, believing one mistake means permanent failure
target_behavior.function: Using high-pressure emotions to keep oneself on guard to maintain control (a maladaptive strategy)
target_behavior.consequence: Producing hopelessness and Increased stress, affecting mental health and weight-loss goal progress
